acceptance: AC-001: Given a completed-task Change whose managed worktree is dirty, application list/detail and registered get_change report blocked readiness, checks not-run for that preflight, and no executable finalization; their captured basis fields match.

AC-002: Given a clean completed-task Change, show_finalization_context and displayed Finalize agree on candidate/readiness; editing the workspace after the read but before finalize_change causes managed validation to reject without a finalization receipt.

AC-003: Given a failed maintained check or preflight submitted through registered report_finalization_failure with current basis, restart returns its retained category, candidate and checks state while branch, claims, frontier stage and proof receipts remain unchanged.
AC-004: Given the same attempt key and payload twice, submission returns one record; changed payload, stale new basis or mismatched report sequence conflicts without overwriting current evidence.

AC-005: Given a newer candidate/contract, prior reports remain historical and cannot block that candidate; a same-head report alone cannot veto a currently eligible retry or clear an existing lifecycle guard.

AC-006: Given malformed frontier bytes for a known Change, registered MCP output, HTTP list/detail and Cockpit emit the tagged unavailable variant with no mutation action; unrelated entries remain visible and strict parsing still rejects the malformed bytes.

AC-007: Given interruption between report/pointer publication or an injected store write error, restart replays the bounded transaction or shows report-store-unavailable without changing product authority or claiming report success.

AC-008: Given unknown raw-summary, command, URL, log, environment or proof fields, or encoded report size above 16 KiB, validation rejects before persistence; stored fields follow the declared structured report contract.

AC-009: Given a finalizer with trusted context and failed preflight, its registered failure-report handoff retains an identity and says checks did not run; no checkout mutation, claim recovery, or successful finalization occurs.

AC-010: Given ready, blocked, unavailable, running, waiting and complete readiness fixtures, Cockpit renders the engine-selected action/explanation and labels copied prompts as copying, not agent launch.

AC-011: Given successful same-candidate finalization after a failed attempt, the success receipt is current and report history survives pointer retirement; retirement failure cannot replace successful status, and an ordinary read creates or retires no report.

AC-012: Given the P01/P02/P02-W/P03/P04 surfaces in this Design's Packet and Native Planning Scope section, routed core/adapter/HTTP/component checks and registered finalizer handoff pass; known-unavailable remains distinct from unknown Change.
AC-013: Given custody reporting with a changed workspace fingerprint or paths escaping/mismatching engine-observed dirt, reporting rejects without checkout edits or pointer advancement.
AC-014: Given 256 retained reports, the next new attempt returns diagnostic-capacity without deleting history; replay of an existing key returns its original record.

AC-015: Given a per-Change Git inspection timeout, missing workspace, or permission error during list/detail capture, readiness is unavailable with workspace-inspection-failed and no executable finalization; unrelated entries remain usable and mutation rechecks do not assume cleanliness.

AC-016: Given symlinked/non-directory report-root components or an escaped transaction target, report persistence rejects without touching an outside sentinel; authoritative portable snapshot export excludes host-local reports.

AC-017: Given the effective inspect-change prompt configuration, only read-only get_change and delivery_health are available; no terminal, edit, dispatch or Delivery mutation tools are exposed, and fixture outputs explain blockers without raw Git repair instructions.
outcomes.promise: Cockpit and agents receive one snapshot-consistent executable action decision and can inspect failed or unstarted finalization after restart without manual worktree repair or weakened authority.

contract.title: Delivery Action Readiness and Failure Visibility

acceptance_observations: P01-A1 / AC-001,002: Given clean and dirty completed-task workspaces, application list/detail/get_change/finalization context expose consistent captured candidate/basis and permit Finalize only when current guards pass; dirty preflight says not-run. An edit after read makes finalize_change reject without receipt.

P01-A2 / AC-003,004,005,013: Given a current report then restart, report identity/category/candidate/checks persist while branch, claims, stage and proof remain unchanged. Identical replay survives candidate change; conflicting payload, stale new basis, wrong sequence/fingerprint or escaping/mismatched dirt leaves pointer unchanged. Prior reports do not veto eligible retry or clear guards.

P01-A3 / AC-007,011: Given interruption, write error, corruption and later same-candidate success with retirement error, restart replays contained prior transaction or exposes report-store-unavailable; current success stays current and history remains. Ordinary reads create or retire no report.

P01-A4 / AC-008,014,016: Given forbidden fields, encoded size above 16 KiB, 256 retained reports, unsafe roots, symlink swap or escaped recovery target, public reporting rejects prohibited writes; old-key replay still returns its original record, outside sentinel stays unchanged, and portable export omits reports.

P01-A5 / AC-006,015: Given malformed known frontier or required workspace timeout/missing/permission failure, affected list/detail entry is typed unavailable without mutation action and with null unobserved fingerprint; another Change stays usable and strict frontier parsing rejects malformed bytes.
constraints: Delivery domain; serial selected task in the supplied Change worktree/branch with independent exact-commit review. Before P01 acquisition require evidence of released/activated selected-launch prerequisite and effective Builder GPT-6 Astra (copilot) with Claude Opus 5 (copilot) independent review. Preserve selected model pairing: Opus implementation reviewed by Astra, Luna by Opus. No silent model substitution or acquisition of unrelated Changes.

Use admitted readiness precedence: unavailable authority, active/uncertain operation, paused/terminal, request/dependency, unobservable required workspace, failed workspace preflight, supported action. Inspect needed workspace once per response with bounded Git timeout; skip inspection when not an action prerequisite. Null unknown basis, never synthetic hashes or inferred cleanliness.

Consult persisted discovery before runtime construction; distinguish known-unavailable from unknown. Preserve strict canonical parsing, trusted semantic detail and last proof. Reads create no claims, attempts, repairs, publication, reports or pointer retirement; previously persisted transaction recovery remains permitted.

Report fields bind contract/frontier digests, candidate/reviewed heads, nonnegative diagnostic sequence and 1..128 ASCII A-Za-z0-9._- attempt key. Use custody-preflight|maintained-check|independent-review categories, fixed code enum, not-run|failed|unknown checks, optional engine-resolved check_id/exit_status, custody fingerprint and at most 32 bounded contained engine-verified dirty paths. Reject undeclared raw/proof fields; engine supplies identity/time/safe summary and non-proof producer.

Derive storage solely from injected trusted runtime root/finalization-reports/<change-id>/ with reports/<engine-report-id>.json and current.json. Dedicated per-Change report lock, RuntimeTransaction and explicit recovery roots; reject symlink/non-directory components, symlink swaps, unsafe files and escaped participants without fallback roots. Check encoded size <=16 KiB before write and retain at most 256 reports without eviction.

Identical key/payload replay returns original report before fresh-basis/capacity rejection, including changed candidates, without moving newer pointer. New attempts require current sequence/basis and observed custody facts. Reports do not veto eligible retries or clear lifecycle guards; changed candidate/contract makes old reports historical.

Preserve effect-boundary managed validation. Successful same-candidate finalization retires matching pointer/sequence only; preserve history and prioritize current success receipt even on retirement/store failure. Missing store means no prior report; corruption is report-store-unavailable without deleting/reblessing bytes.
No dependency change expected; justified resolution changes own uv.lock and uv lock --check in this task. Do not bypass maintained gates.
exclusions: MCP/HTTP/UI/agent behavior changes and selected-launch prerequisite implementation
